title: beesha baccifera
intro: Beesha baccifera, commonly known as Beech tree or Beech bark, is a type of deciduous tree belonging to the Fagaceae family. The health benefits of Beesha baccifera include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Beesha baccifera include being used as a laxative, treating fever, and serving as an expectorant. The bioactive constituents of Beesha baccifera include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
